description:
[Merchant] A placement's QR code (carrying the placement's payware link, https://go.payware.eu/{placementId}, which needs no API call) or Code 128 barcode (carrying the plain ID), for print. PNG and JPG come back as an image, SVG as its markup.

**Endpoint:** GET /products/{productId}/placements/{placementId}/image

placementId.description: The placement's ID: pl + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pl7e4rCToG

productId.description: The product's ID: pr + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pr7e4rCToG

type.description: QR code or barcode. Default QR

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_products_get_placement_image
